intro.title: Cash Register Shifts & Drawer Audit
intro.subtitle: Opening cash float, real-time drawer calculations, interim X-Reports, and closing Z-Report audits

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 17: Cash Register Shifts and Drawer Reconciliation. Eliminate cash discrepancies and audit cashier handovers with automated register controls.
Press F4 or navigate to Sales Register to open the drawer management portal. Enter your opening float tally to unlock the billing counter for your shift.
MediFlow computes expected drawer cash continuously: starting float plus counter cash collections and receipts, minus cash returns and drawer payouts.
For lunchtime spot-checks or manager audits, click X-Report or press Alt plus P to generate an interim non-closing summary on your thermal receipt printer.
At shift handover, click Close Register, enter counted currency denominations, and lock the shift to print the closing Z-Report. In Part 18, we redeem Customer Loyalty Points!

outro.takeaway: Register Reconciliation: Enforce opening float verification, live expected cash formulas, mid-shift X-Reports, and closing Z-Report denomination audits.
